Active flag: Y = active customer; N = inactive
Customer city
Customer registration date as a yyyymmdd integer
Customer phone number (digits only)
Customer credit limit, a number stored as text (blank when none)
Transaction identifier
Customer code of the buyer (refers to crm.customers.customer_code; undeclared)
Transaction date as a yyyymmdd integer
Transaction time of day as an hhmmss integer
Quantity sold
Unit price
Transaction amount = quantity × unit price
Transaction status code: OK, CN (cancelled), RT (returned)
Store code where the sale happened (refers to store.stores.store_code; undeclared)
Currency code of the transaction (ISO 4217)
Parameter group of a generic lookup table (STS = statuses, CUR = currencies, RSN = return reasons, CTY = cities, STR = stores)
Parameter key within its group (e.g. a store code in group STR)
Parameter value: the label or description of the key
